programme.title: På jakt etter regnet
programme.desc: Følg Anastasia når flokken hennes deler seg for å beskytte to dyrebare elefantunger. Geparden Kuleta tar tilbake territorium til ungene hun har igjen. Villhunden Phoenix leter etter en ny make mens himmelens sluser åpner seg og regnet begynner å lege den knusktørre jorden.

programme.title: Store katter: Ni liv
programme.desc: Følg løvens ni livsfaser, fra forsvarsløs unge til selvsikker voksen og aldrende i eksil. Se at rivalisering, sult og flokkdynamikk former livet deres på Serengeti, og vær vitne til lojaliteten og samarbeidet som gjør denne sosiale katten unik.

programme.title: Store katter: Ni liv
programme.desc: Naviger skogen med en liten unge, se unge voksne kreve sitt territorie, og vær vitne til det uunngåelige eksilet til eldre jegere. Oppdag hvordan instinkt og list hjelper tigeren med å overleve sin ensomme verden, der hver avgjørelse medfører risiko.

programme.title: Store katter: Ni liv
programme.desc: Kjemp mot tøff natur og konstante utfordringer, og se hvordan leoparden alltid er smartere enn fienden for å sikre mat og beskytte sine små. Kryss isdekte topper og tørre elveleier, der ett møte kan endre kattens skjebne til det bedre eller verre.

programme.title: Snøleoparder med Dan O'Neill
programme.desc: Reis gjennom hjertet av Sentral-Asia med biolog og naturforsker Dan O’Neill i et kappløp mot tiden på jakt etter den gåtefulle snøleoparden. Opplev den rå, ufiltrerte oppførselen til disse majestetiske skapningene som aldri tidligere har blitt vist.

programme.title: Snøleoparder med Dan O'Neill
programme.desc: Snus deg rundt The Dudes territorie med Dan og teamet hans, som mistenker at hunner kan spille en større rolle enn først antatt. Still tidligere forskning om snølepoarders oppførsel til veggs når Dan snubler over en uvanlig gruppe store kattedyr.

programme.title: Afrikas jegere
programme.desc: Et banebrytende varmekamera avslører den hemmelige tilværelsen til nattaktive rovdyr. Følg med når en av de eldste leopardene vi kjenner til, kjemper for å klare seg mot de fryktinnjagende naboene sine: en flokk løver på jakt etter mat.

programme.title: Vulkanske reiser
programme.desc: Danakilfordypningen i Etiopia er ikke bare et av verdens mest ugjestmilde steder, men også et av de mest geologisk aktive. Nå tar vulkanologen Tom Pfeiffer en gruppe opplevelsesturister med for å krysse Danakil for å se vulkanen Erte Ale.

programme.title: Lekende dyr
programme.desc: Unge hyener konkurrerer i drakamp, uskikkelige papegøyer leker ved å plukke fra hverandre turistbiler, og flekkdelfiner nyter sofistikerte sosiale leker i tangen – og alle følger spesifikke regler som finpusser sosiale bånd.

programme.title: Det ekstreme Afrika
programme.desc: Fjellkjeden Drakensberg i Sør-Afrika er et av de mest imponerende landskapene på kontinentet. Klima og miljø endrer seg jo høyere du kommer i de bratte fjellsidene, og både dyrene på landjorden og rovfuglene i luften må takle skiftende fysiske forhold.

programme.title: Det ekstreme Afrika
programme.desc: Nord i Tanzania kneiser fjellene rundt en dramatisk dal. Dalsidene er beriket av eldgamle vulkaner, og inneholder en rekke ulike habitater der planter og dyr trives. I bunnen av dalen finnes det vann selv på de tørreste tidene av året.

programme.title: Det ekstreme Afrika
programme.desc: I Simienfjellene nasjonalpark i Etiopia finner vi noen av de sjeldneste dyrene i verden. Få et innblikk i livet på noen av de høyeste fjelltoppene i Afrika, der raggete, gressetende geladaer, sky etiopiske ulver og etiopiske steinbukker holder stand.

programme.title: Det ekstreme Afrika
programme.desc: Tørrområdene sør i Afrika er en reise inn i de tørreste og mest ekstreme miljøene i de mest avsidesliggende delene av kontinentet. På spektakulære, men farlige steder der det nesten aldri regner, finner vi svært robuste dyr som har funnet sin måte å overleve på. Tørrområdene har noen utrolige beboere, fra de største pattedyrene til de raskeste insektene, og til og med en spøkelsesaktig fisk som ikke finnes andre steder i verden. Alle må håndtere de daglige utfordringene som fører med det å leve på et av verdens mest ugjestmilde steder.

programme.title: Det ekstreme Afrika
programme.desc: Etosha var en gang en stor innsjø som tørket inn, og nå bare fylles med vann i regntiden om sommeren. Når Etosha er full av vann, samles myriader av vannfugler ved den grunne innsjøen for å hekke, deriblant rosenflamingo og dvergflamingo.

programme.title: Det ekstreme Afrika
programme.desc: Følg elva Oranje i Sør-Afrika fra kilden til den strømmer ut i Atlanterhavet. Langs veien møter vi en rekke ulike habitater og dyrene som holder til her, fra tørrområdene i Richtersveld til de vakre Augrabiesfallene. Dette er historien om den lineære oasen. Vi viser hvordan dyrene har tilpasset seg for å overleve langs elven, og utforsker en frodig verden full av planter og dyr.

programme.title: Skipsvrak
programme.desc: Yucatánhalvøya i Mexico har en lang og innholdsrik maritim historie som omfatter alt fra opportunistiske sjørøverskip til tungt bevæpnede marineskip.

programme.title: Historier fra Zambia
programme.desc: I dette lille skogsområdet går to unge aper gjennom den vanskeligste tiden i livet. Mens de prøver å finne sin plass i verden, må de også lære hvilke naboer som er venner og hvilke som er fiender. Hvem skal de stole på, og hvem skal de unngå? De opplever tap og får venner, og oppdager hva det betyr å være en del av Skogflokken.

programme.title: Historier fra Zambia
programme.desc: Villmarken i Zambia er et hardt sted å leve. Her må mange dyr gå sammen i grupper for å hjelpe til med å forsvare territoriet, beskytte ungene, finne mat og unnslippe rovdyr.

programme.title: Historier fra Zambia
programme.desc: Hver eneste dag blir det oppdaget et kadaver i Luangwadalen. Alle forteller historien om hvordan de døde. I CSI: Safari undersøker vi hva som tok livet av tre kadavre som er funnet ...

programme.title: Historier fra Zambia
programme.desc: I Zambia finner vi tre svært spesielle og ulike afrikanske paradis: den lavtliggende, hete Luangwadalen, den høytliggende, tørre Liuwasletten og den kjølige, våte Kasanka nasjonalpark. Alle stedene defineres av jorden de ligger på og formes av årstidene, og tilbyr noe unikt til dyrene som velger å slå seg ned her.

programme.title: Ikoniske villdyr
programme.desc: Å overleve på savannen i Afrika krever snarrådighet og sluhet, spesielt for to av jegerne: den afrikanske villhunden og dvergmungoen. Disse to mystiske artene lever i flokk og er avhengig av nøye koordinert lagarbeid for å klare seg. Begge artene trenger den sammensveisede familien sin for å overvinne de daglige utfordringene, fra å ta seg av ungene til å finne mat og holde fiender på avstand.

programme.title: Ikoniske villdyr
programme.desc: Alt livet på jorden styres av et avansert nettverk av relasjoner. Alle arter er forbundet med hverandre, og ingen kan overleve alene. Selv om noen forhold er ensidige, er andre gjensidig nyttige. Alt har sin plass i naturens overordnede plan, fra løse forbindelser til nære partnerskap. Komplekse samhandlinger mellom arter er ikke en gang begrenset til dyrene, og noen av de beste eksemplene på dette finner vi i de frodige fjellskogene i Afrika.

programme.title: Ikoniske villdyr
programme.desc: Nilkrokodillen og flodhesten er to av Afrikas ikoniske amfibier som lever i ferskvann. De finnes i kanaler, elver og innsjøer på hele kontinentet, deriblant den storslåtte villmarken Kwa-Zulu Natal i Sør-Afrika. Disse to artene har eksistert side om side i tusenvis av år, og har utviklet seg på ulike måter til et liv i vann.

programme.title: Tusker: Elefantenes brorskap
programme.desc: Fordyp deg i de intrikate livene til tuskers med Craig, Pascal og Esau, tre afrikanske hann-elefanter i alle livets stadier. Få et sjeldent innblikk i det subtile språket, kompleks samhandling og dype bånd hos verdens største pattedyr på land.

programme.title: Elefanthistorier
programme.desc: Følg eventyrene til tre elefanter i tre særegne habitater i Afrika. Sammen forteller de historien om hvordan disse emosjonelle og intelligente dyrene har utviklet seg gjennom millioner av år for å overleve på dette kontinentet.

programme.title: Hakkespetter – hele historien
programme.desc: Marsjer til den taktfaste trommelyden av en unik fuglefamilie. Finn ut hvorfor verdens 239 store og små hakkespettarter er naturens beste tømmerhuggere. Se hvordan de flyr, klatrer og kaller på hverandre, og få et innblikk i de hemmelige redene deres.

programme.title: En bies dagbok
programme.desc: I en bikube jobber titusenvis av små dyr sammen mot et felles mål: koloniens overlevelse. Men hvordan er livet for en enkelt honningbie? En bies dagbok forteller deg den historien.

programme.title: Ikoniske villdyr

programme.title: Vulkanske reiser
programme.desc: Besøk Anak Krakatoa når den går inn i en voldsom fase. Denne vulkanen er kjent som “Ildens barn”, og er en av Krakatoas forfedre, en vulkan kjent for det største utbruddet i nyere historie. Vil dens etterfølger gjenta mønsteret?

programme.title: Månens ville side
programme.desc: Dra ut på episke reiser styrt av månens kraft. Se hvordan usynlige signaler styrer hvaler og skilpadders migrasjonsruter i havet, fly på tvers av kontinenter med nattravner, og se kompostbiller og andre insekter navigere ved hjelp av måneskinnet.

programme.title: Kimberley - Australias ville vestkyst
programme.desc: Unngå skjelldekte og fjærkledde farer med wallabyer, se krageagamer kjempe om maker, og bli med på etegilde med nyklekkede krokodiller. Utforsk farlige stryk og forstår den kulturelle og biologiske viktigheten av en lokal elv i regnsesongen.

programme.title: Store katter: Ni liv
programme.desc: Naviger skogen med en liten unge, se unge voksne kreve sitt territorie, og vær vitne til det uunngåelige eksilet til eldre jegere. Oppdag hvordan instinkt og list hjelper tigeren med å overleve sin ensomme verden, der hver avgjørelse medfører risiko.

programme.title: Superbeist
programme.desc: Bøy deg i støvet for en av naturens eldste og farligste utholdenhetsrovdyr. Se tigerhaier utnytte kaoset når skilpadder legger egg, overlev oksygenfattige områder med epauletthaier, og motstå det knusende trykket fra dypet med havmusene.

programme.title: Superbeist
programme.desc: Trål havet med alle slags haier, og se hvorfor disse rovfiskene er overlegne under havoverflaten. Finn veien gjennom korallabyrinter med revhaier, ligg på lur for det perfekte angrepet med skjegghaier, og dra på en episk forflytning med hvithaiene.

programme.title: Røtter
programme.desc: På tvers av bølgete sanddyner, i de vindblåste gressområdene i den sørlige Kalahari tårner et praktfullt kameltre. Den har stått her i to århundrer. Dette treet er aldri ensomt, lær hvordan det gir mat, ly og et jaktterreng til mange skapninger.

programme.title: Historier fra Zambia
programme.desc: I Luangwadalen i Zambia lever Afrikas største og mest fryktinngytende kjemper, men det som virkelig gjør dalen spesiell, er fuglene. Det finnes over 400 ulike fuglearter her, og alle er perfekt tilpasset for å utnytte alle mulighetene som finnes.

programme.desc: Bøy deg i støvet for en av naturens eldste og farligste utholdenhetsrovdyr. Se tigerhaier utnytte kaoset når skilpadder legger egg, overlev oksygenfattige områder med epauletthaier, og motstå det knusende trykket fra dypet med havmusene.

programme.title: Superbeist
programme.desc: Trål havet med alle slags haier, og se hvorfor disse rovfiskene er overlegne under havoverflaten. Finn veien gjennom korallabyrinter med revhaier, ligg på lur for det perfekte angrepet med skjegghaier, og dra på en episk forflytning med hvithaiene.

programme.title: Røtter
programme.desc: På tvers av bølgete sanddyner, i de vindblåste gressområdene i den sørlige Kalahari tårner et praktfullt kameltre. Den har stått her i to århundrer. Dette treet er aldri ensomt, lær hvordan det gir mat, ly og et jaktterreng til mange skapninger.

programme.title: Historier fra Zambia
programme.desc: I Luangwadalen i Zambia lever Afrikas største og mest fryktinngytende kjemper, men det som virkelig gjør dalen spesiell, er fuglene. Det finnes over 400 ulike fuglearter her, og alle er perfekt tilpasset for å utnytte alle mulighetene som finnes.

programme.title: Månens ville side
programme.desc: Dra ut på episke reiser styrt av månens kraft. Se hvordan usynlige signaler styrer hvaler og skilpadders migrasjonsruter i havet, fly på tvers av kontinenter med nattravner, og se kompostbiller og andre insekter navigere ved hjelp av måneskinnet.

programme.title: Kimberley - Australias ville vestkyst
programme.desc: Unngå skjelldekte og fjærkledde farer med wallabyer, se krageagamer kjempe om maker, og bli med på etegilde med nyklekkede krokodiller. Utforsk farlige stryk og forstår den kulturelle og biologiske viktigheten av en lokal elv i regnsesongen.

programme.title: Ikoniske villdyr
programme.desc: Nilkrokodillen og flodhesten er to av Afrikas ikoniske amfibier som lever i ferskvann. De finnes i kanaler, elver og innsjøer på hele kontinentet, deriblant den storslåtte villmarken Kwa-Zulu Natal i Sør-Afrika. Disse to artene har eksistert side om side i tusenvis av år, og har utviklet seg på ulike måter til et liv i vann.

programme.title: Vivaldi : Juditha Triumphans - Greek National Opera
programme.desc: Juditha triumphans Oratorio d’Antonio Vivadi (1678 – 1741) Livret de Iacopo Cassetti. Armonia Atenea, Il Pomo d'Oro, GNO Chorus, GNO Children's Choir. Athènes, Opéra National Grecque, 20 avril 2021. ‘Juditha triumphans’ est basé sur un livret latin de Iacopo Cassetti, lui-même inspiré du Livre de Judith de l'Ancien Testament. Le roi de Babylone Nabuchodonosor envoie son général Holopherne conquérir la ville de Béthulie en Israël. Pour sauver ses compatriotes israélites, la courageuse Judith décide de séduire Holopherne. Quand il s'endort, elle lui coupe la tête. ‘Juditha triumphans’ est le seul oratorio existant des quatre que Vivaldi a composés. L'intense atmosphère de guerre s’écoute dans les dramatiques parties chorales, et la foi et l'intégrité de Judith à travers l'écriture lyrique et tendre. Il convient de noter l'utilisation de nombreux instruments rares, tels que la viole d'amour, les chalumeaux et les théorbes dans les moments les plus significatifs de l’œuvre. Opéra.

programme.title: Electronic Vibrations - A sound changes the world
programme.desc: Whether techno or hip-hop – electronic music is nowadays the driving force of pop culture. We have almost forgotten that its origins lie in the WDR’s electronic studio, which made Cologne to one of the centres of the avant-garde during the post-war years. This is the story of how a room full of strange devices would become a cabinet of curiosities, the vibrations of which sent the whole world in a state of ecstasy. From the beginnings directly after the Second World War in Paris with Pierre Schaeffer’s ‘musique concrète’, the film focuses on Stockhausen and goes on to Kraftwerk, from Jean-Michel Jarre and the IRCAM studio right up to Detroit to the beginnings of techno.Subtitles available for this program with your remote control.

programme.desc: Whether techno or hip-hop – electronic music is nowadays the driving force of pop culture. We have almost forgotten that its origins lie in the WDR’s electronic studio, which made Cologne to one of the centres of the avant-garde during the post-war years. This is the story of how a room full of strange devices would become a cabinet of curiosities, the vibrations of which sent the whole world in a state of ecstasy. From the beginnings directly after the Second World War in Paris with Pierre Schaeffer’s ‘musique concrète’, the film focuses on Stockhausen and goes on to Kraftwerk, from Jean-Michel Jarre and the IRCAM studio right up to Detroit to the beginnings of techno.Subtitles available for this program with your remote control.

programme.title: Wagner's Jews
programme.desc: Richard Wagner was notoriously anti-Semitic, and his writings on Jews were later embraced by Hitler and the Nazis. But for years, many of Wagner‘s closest associates were Jews - young musicians who became personally devoted to him, and provided crucial help to his work and career. Why were they drawn to him? And how could Wagner even accept their embrace? These questions are at the heart of ‘Wagner‘s Jews’, the first film to focus on Wagner‘s complex personal relationships with Jews. Filmed on location in Germany, Switzerland, and Italy, ‘Wagner‘s Jews’ reveals this remarkable story through archival sources, re-enactments, interviews, and performances of original musical works by Wagner‘s Jewish colleagues. Featuring Zubin Mehta and Leon Botstein among others, the film also explores the ongoing controversy over performing Wagner‘s music in Israel. The same questions asked in Wagner‘s time still resonate today: is it possible to separate the art from its creator? Can sublime music transcend prejudice and bigotry, and the weight of history?Subtitles available for this program with your remote controlSubtítulos disponibles para este programa con su control remoto.

programme.desc: Michael blev snabbt förälskad efter att charmige Fransisco kontaktat honom via direktmeddelande på Twitter. Deras förhållande utvecklades snabbt men sen inträffade det saker som förmörkade kärlekshistorien.

programme.title: Just Tattoo of Us USA
programme.desc: En 'bromans' prövas när nån skämmer ut som bästa kompis. Två systrar ger sig på varandra och får prydas av sina värsta misstag nånsin.

programme.title: Geordie Shore

programme.title: Caught In The Act: Unfaithful
programme.desc: Komikern och contentskaparen Richard menar allvar med modellen Elisa, hans flickvän sen ett år. Han har erfarenhet av sorg, och är rädd att livet är för kort för att ignorera alla varningstecken.

programme.title: Ridiculousness
programme.desc: I det här avsnittet av 'Ridiculousness' ska Rob, Steelo och Rocsi Diaz spela basket med stil i 'Stollar med bollar', upptäcka att vissa dagar är dåliga från första början i 'Direkt en dålig dag' och se rättvisa skipas i 'Vägkarma'.

programme.desc: I det här avsnittet av Ridiculousness är Rob, Steelo och medvärden Rocsi Diaz superförsiktiga men gör fortfarande 'Försiktiga misstag', tappar greppet om 'Överdimensionerad last' och går hem med stil genom att göra 'Coola avsked'.

programme.title: Ridiculousness
programme.desc: I det här avsnittet av 'Ridiculousness' ska Rob, Steelo och Rocsi Diaz flippa ut över 'Halvbakåt', vara snåla i 'Billiga stolar' och se vem som blir 'Däckad'.

programme.title: MTV Unplugged
programme.desc: För att fira Rods Glastonburyspelning vrider vi tillbaka klockan till hans äventyrliga akustiska spelning 1993, då han bjöd på klassiska hits som "Maggie May" samt covers på Van Morrison, Chuck Berry och Tom Waits.

programme.title: Ink Master
programme.desc: Studior faller för pressen när spänningen mellan lagkamraterna trappas upp. Kampen om 200 000 dollar och den första Master Shop-titeln någonsin fortsätter.

programme.title: Ink Master
programme.desc: En av tävlingens mest ökända veteraner återvänder och vänder upp och ner på spelet. Kampen om 200 000 dollar och Master Shop-titeln fortsätter.

programme.title: Ridiculousness
programme.desc: I det här avsnittet av Ridiculousness räddar Rob, Steelo och Lolo Wood fotbollar med ansiktet i 'Ansiktsmålvakter', faller oväntat i 'Falluckor' och öppnar bagage och får 'Bagageöverraskningar'.

programme.title: Ridiculousness
programme.desc: I det här avsnittet av Ridiculousness lär sig Rob, Steelo och Lolo Wood att pappor kan leka hårdhänt i 'Pappaskadad', stöter på hemska kaktusar i 'Kaktuskrockar' och ser hur alkohol påverkar hur man går genom dörrar i 'Fyllon mot dörrar'.

programme.title: Geordie Shore
programme.desc: Nathan frågar James rent ut om han har baktalat honom och det hela blir spänt. Familjen blir nostalgisk och reflekterar över sin tid i serien, vilket får Jay att inse att han måste göra mer för att hela slitningarna inom gruppen.

programme.title: Within The Frame
programme.desc: Au 16ème siècle, le cardinal Scipione Borghèse, neveu du Pape, fait construire une villa pour accueillir spécialement sa collection privée d’œuvres d’art, l’une des plus importantes de l’époque. Achetée par l’Etat italien en 1902, cette collection d’une immense richesse rassemble des chefs d’œuvres inestimables signés par les plus grands artistes. Découvrez ainsi l’une des copies de Léda et le cygne de De Vinci ou le David de Caravage. Bonne visite !

programme.title: Architectures
programme.desc: En 1995, la Ville de Luxembourg décide de faire bâtir une grande salle de concert sur le plateau de Kirchberg, le nouveau quartier des banques et des grandes institutions européennes.L’enjeu de la commande est de réunir trois espaces publics majeurs de représentation dans un même ensemble, une grande salle philharmonique, une petite salle de musique de chambre et un espace découverte. L’architecte Christian de Portzamparc, secondé admirablement par l’expérience de l’acousticien Xu Yaying, fait de cette salle son grand instrument de musique. De forme elliptique, la Philharmonie avec son filtre de colonnes blanches et ses falaises colorées fait découvrir le grand auditorium comme un véritable joyau dans son écrin, un des plus beaux bâtiments de l’architecte.

programme.title: Artist's Workshop
programme.desc: In the Artist's workshop series, we offer you a privileged meeting with an artist, or the discovery of an artist or an important place for the history of art. Whether they are painters, visual artists, sculptors... These people all have the same passion for art and this show is an opportunity to enter their different universes, to discover what drives them, inspires them and maybe that will give rise to vocations.

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Deux stars des années 70, le crooner cool Tony Christie et la royauté pop Jimmy Osmond, sont accompagnés des experts Catherine Southon et Margie Cooper. Partant de la ville de Loughborough, dans le Leicestershire, ils se dirigent vers une vente aux enchères à Stoke-on-Trent, dans le Staffordshire.Tony profite d'une visite à Coalbrookdale, le lieu où des techniques innovantes ont été développées, marquant le début de la révolution industrielle. De son côté, le passionné de voitures Jimmy s'offre un tour sur le circuit historique de Donington.La grande finale aux enchères comprend un moment de chant en groupe unique en son genre. Mais quel maestro musical remportera la victoire ?

programme.title: Photo Contest
programme.desc: In each episode of Photo Contest, two contestants compete on an imposed theme such as rock'n roll, Japan or architecture. They have one hour to take the best possible photographs before editing them for 30 minutes in a studio. The photographs they have selected are then presented to Agnès Grégoire, editor-in-chief of PHOTO magazine, who will have to choose the best photographer.

programme.title: Artist's Workshop
programme.desc: Dans l’Ouest de la banlieue parisienne, nous allons à la découverte de l’atelier de l’artiste Jérôme Zonder. Depuis plus de 10 ans, l’artiste développe un travail virtuose centré sur le dessin. Réalisés au fusain ou à la mine de graphite, ses œuvres sombres et souvent très réalistes suscitent à la fois admiration et effroi. Puissant et complexe, l’art de Jérôme Zonder captive par ses prouesses techniques et questionne notre rapport à la violence.

programme.title: An hour with
programme.desc: Take an hour break to discover the work of an Italian painter, Amedeo Modigliani. You will discover his labour with Caryatid, Lolotte or others portraits.

programme.title: An hour with
programme.desc: Take an hour break to discover the work of a French painter, Pierre Bonnard. You will discover his labour with Woman dozing on a bed, Summer in Normandy or The beach in low tide.

programme.title: Video Art
programme.desc: Street art, performances, digital art... Because the new forms of Art and their invigorating character, even iconoclastic, have been able to attract a new public until now refractory to go inside the interior of our beautiful museums.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.sub-title: Le collectionneur danois : de Delacroix à Gauguin
programme.desc: Wilhelm Hansen fut un homme d’affaires visionnaire, qui vécut au Danemark au XIXème siècle. Il fut l’un des rares collectionneurs à s’intéresser aux peintres impressionnistes, à une époque où ils étaient attaqués et dénigrés. Le film nous amène dans la maison d’été de Hansen dans la banlieue de Copenhague et nous fait visiter l’extraordinaire exposition à la Royal Academy de Londres consacrée à sa collection.

programme.title: Within The Frame
programme.desc: Joseph Mallord William Turner fut l’un des plus grands paysagistes du XIXe siècle. Singulier et avant-gardiste, il a su crée un art très personnel, qui lui a valu le surnom de « peintre de la lumière », tant il frôlait la perfection dans l'art d'évoquer une atmosphère. Cette exposition vous permettra de découvrir ses célèbres marines et ses vues vénitiennes ou anglaises mais, avec La supplique de l'écrivain pauvre, vous verrez aussi que Turner n’était pas seulement un brillant paysagiste… Bonne visite !

programme.title: Art Quiz
programme.desc: Test and develop your artistic culture with Art Quiz, the game that will allow you to become unaware of art. Whether it's artists, works of art, artistic trends, the price of works... nothing will be a secret for you anymore. Now it's your turn to play!

programme.title: My little Museum
programme.desc: My little Museum is Art History retold through funny anecdotes and backstage trivias by Alicia Flipo. With her wacky demeanor, her inventiveness and her quirky sense of humor, Alicia stages these small Art tales so that once and for all, you could remember the Big stories!

programme.title: Architectures
programme.desc: En plein essor capitaliste, Scott et Barlow créent pour la gare de Saint Pancras à Londres, la plus grande voûte métallique, adossée a un luxueux hôtel néogothique.

programme.title: Architectures
programme.sub-title: Nemausus 1, a low-income housing project from the 1980s
programme.desc: Nemausus 1, designed by Jean Nouvel in Nîmes during the 1980s, is a public housing project with bold lines resembling a modern ocean liner. Breaking away from the stereotypes of social housing, the building offers spacious, bright, and flexible living spaces aimed at improving residents' quality of life. Nouvel used industrial materials such as steel and aluminum to give the structure a contemporary and durable aesthetic. The architecture of Nemausus 1 embodies a utopian vision, where social housing is synonymous with comfort and innovation. This project marked a turning point in public housing design in France.

programme.title: Street Art Lyon, viewpoints
programme.desc: The official art (with the co-ownerships) of the painted walls of Lyon hides its origins: the art of the wild graffiti.

programme.title: Printing photography
programme.desc: Photographer Bruno Dewaele asks Antoine Agoudjian for several large silver prints as he prepares an exhibition.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: Qui était Frida Kahlo ? Voyagez dans la vie d'une véritable icône, découvrez son art et la vérité qui se cache derrière sa vie souvent mouvementée. La combinaison d'interviews, de commentaires et d'une exploration détaillée de l'art de Kahlo, offre un trésor de couleurs et un festin de vitalité. Ce documentaire personnel et intime offre un accès privilégié à ses œuvres, et met en lumière sa créativité fébrile, sa résilience et sa soif inégalée pour la vie.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: 200 years after it opened and a century after acquiring its first Van Gogh works, the National Gallery hosted the largest Van Gogh exhibition ever held in the UK (September 14, 2024 to January 19, 2025). The exhibition was a huge success, unanimously praised by the press, and tickets sold out quickly, making this film the only way to see what Forbes called a “once-in-a-lifetime exhibition.”Discover the passion that drove one of the world's most beloved artists to revolutionize art. Van Gogh: Poets & Lovers rewrites history and celebrates Van Gogh's genius without exploiting his suffering, allowing audiences to truly understand this iconic artist in a whole new way...

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Les actrices et amies de Casualty, Susan Cookson et Suzanne Packer, troquent leurs blouses de chirurgie contre une Sunbeam Tiger de 1965 pour se lancer dans une compétition à travers le Nord-Ouest de l’Angleterre, accompagnées des experts James Braxton et David Harper.Susan découvre son côté négociatrice, tandis que Suzanne garde un œil très vigilant sur le budget, cherchant à trouver un objet vraiment ancien.Au fil du voyage à travers le Yorkshire, elles ont l'opportunité de rencontrer une femme très spéciale de Sheffield et de visiter des jardins incroyables avec une histoire fascinante.

programme.title: Within The Frame
programme.desc: Discover or re-discover the masterpieces of the greatest painters of history through our documentary series Within The Frame. From impressionists to surrealists, from Leonard Da Vinci to Paul Cézanne, every episode will immerge you into a virtual tour of a paintings collection. You will see the most impressive paintings ever made and won't miss a single detail.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: With loans from across the world, this major retrospective brings together Vermeer’s most famous masterpieces including Girl with a Pearl Earring, The Geographer, The Milkmaid, The Little Street, Lady Writing a Letter with her Maid, and Woman Holding a Balance. In all, 28 of his surviving 37 works. This film invites audiences to a privileged view of the exhibition, accompanied by the director of the Rijksmuseum and the curators of the show. A truly once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to discover the genius of Vermeer and his fascinating and mysterious life.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.sub-title: Le curieux monde de Hieronymus Bosch
programme.desc: La ville natale de Bosch aux Pays-Bas ne possède pas de tableaux du peintre et pourtant, pour la grande exposition « Visions of Genius » qui a eu lieu à l’anniversaire de sa mort en 2016, le musée Noordbrabants a réussi à réunir la presque totalité des tableaux et dessins de Bosch. C’est en 2008 que le directeur du musée a commencé sa tournée dans les plus grands musées d’Europe et Etats-Unis pour en persuader les directeurs de prêter au musée Noordbrabants leurs œuvres, en échange d’un travail d’analyse et de recherche sur les tableaux en prêt. Ainsi « Hieronymus Bosch. Visions of Genius » a été l’exposition la plus ambitieuse dédiée au peintre hollandais. Ce documentaire sera une plongée dans l’univers étrange et visionnaire de Hieronymus Bosch.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: Lucian Freud, l'un des peintres britanniques les plus célèbres de notre époque, est également l'un des rares artistes du XXe siècle à s'être représenté dans un autoportrait avec une telle constance. Ses autoportraits donnent un aperçu fascinant à la fois de sa personnalité et de son évolution en tant que peintre, depuis son premier portrait peint en 1939 jusqu'au dernier. Grâce à des entretiens fascinants avec d'anciens modèles, des amis et d'éminents experts, ce documentaire intensément captivant révèle l'œuvre d'un maître qui représente une étude captivante sur la dynamique du vieillissement et le processus d'autoreprésentation.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: With loans from across the world, this major retrospective brings together Vermeer’s most famous masterpieces including Girl with a Pearl Earring, The Geographer, The Milkmaid, The Little Street, Lady Writing a Letter with her Maid, and Woman Holding a Balance. In all, 28 of his surviving 37 works. This film invites audiences to a privileged view of the exhibition, accompanied by the director of the Rijksmuseum and the curators of the show. A truly once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to discover the genius of Vermeer and his fascinating and mysterious life.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.sub-title: Degas : une passion de la perfection
programme.desc: Exhibition on screen nous emmène à travers les rues de Paris puis au cœur d’une superbe exposition au Fitzwilliam Museum de Cambridge, dont l’impressionnante collection d’œuvres de Degas est la plus représentative de Grande-Bretagne. Ayant bénéficié d’un accès exclusif à une grande variété d’œuvres rares, le film raconte l’histoire fascinante de la quête de perfection de Degas à travers l’expérimentation de nouvelles techniques et les leçons apprises en étudiant les grands maîtres.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: Without Camille Pissarro, there is no Impressionist movement. He is rightfully known as the father of Impressionism.It was a dramatic path that Pissarro followed, and throughout it all he wrote extensively to his family. It is through these intimate and revealing letters that this gripping film reveals Pissarro’s life and work.Born in the West Indies, Pissarro found his passion in paint as a young man in Paris, and by the age of 43 had corralled a group of enthusiastic artists into a new collective. Their first show was scorned by the critics, but the group had acquired a new name: the Impressionists. For the next 40 years Pissarro was the driving force behind what has today become the world’s favourite artistic movement.The Ashmolean Museum has a long tradition of excellence. As the UK’s first ever public museum (it opened its doors in May 1683) it houses a wonderfully rich collection, including the remarkable Pissarro archive. With exclusive access to most extensive archive of.

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.sub-title: Tanni Grey Thompson and Jade Jones
programme.desc: Aujourd'hui, nous sommes dans le Nord-Est de l'Angleterre avec les grandes paralympiennes en fauteuil roulant Tanni Grey-Thompson et Jade Jones. Tanni, avec son impressionnant palmarès de médailles et de records, est accompagnée de sa jeune protégée Jade, qui débute sa carrière en athlétisme.Avec les experts Phil Serrell et David Harper, la baronne du comté de Durham et Jade, de Middlesbrough, partiront à la recherche d'antiquités à vendre lors d'une vente aux enchères à Harrogate.Tanni tente également sa chance dans la fabrication traditionnelle du verre, tandis que Jade découvre l'histoire de l'homme qui fut un pionnier du design dans la région.

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Le rockeur progressif Rick Wakeman et son grand ami Ian Lavender, célèbre pour son rôle de Pike dans Dad’s Army, s’offrent une joyeuse virée sur les routes secondaires du Norfolk. Accompagnés des experts Raj Bisram et David Harper, ces deux chasseurs d’antiquités sillonnent le comté à la recherche de trésors à vendre aux enchères à Nottingham.Rick découvre d’anciens graffitis médiévaux cachés dans la cathédrale de Norwich, tandis qu’Ian fait un détour vers le nord du Norfolk pour admirer la plus grande collection de soldats miniatures au monde.Mais un sage vieil homme japonais aidera-t-il Ian à triompher aux enchères ?

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.sub-title: Léonard à la National Gallery de Londres
programme.desc: Un événement remarquable s'est produit à la National Gallery de Londres lorsque la plus grande collection jamais constituée de peintures de Léonard de Vinci a été réunie dans une exposition unique : Léonard de Vinci : peintre à la cour de Milan. Léonard est reconnu comme étant peut-être le plus grand peintre et sculpteur de tous les temps, mais ses talents ne s'arrêtaient pas là. Ce film raconte sa vie et s'étend sur Léonard le visionnaire, Léonard l'inventeur. Depuis l'endroit où il a vécu ses dernières années au Château du Clos Lucé en France, nous verrons que Léonard de Vinci était peut-être l'incarnation même de l'esprit de la Renaissance.

programme.title: Masterpieces Unveiled
programme.sub-title: Bosch, The Garden Of Earthly Delights
programme.desc: This is Triptych of Earthly Delights: how did the great masterpiece by Jeroen Anthoniszoon van Aken, known as Hieronymus Bosch, come to be created, when was it painted, what was it used for, and what does it really represent? No one knows; for most of bosch’s works no documents or precise information about buyers exist. even the dating itself is complicated. Historians, archivists, and art critics have tried everything. A veil of mystery envelops his entire artistic production, giving rise to the most varied rumours but for now searching for clues in the local traditions, in the writings in latin, french, german and dutch, searching for possible iconographic precedents and parallels, peering into the murky mirror of magical rites and heresies, delving into alchemy treatises, and pulling out from the fog of history figures who had practically been forgotten. The search goes on, but for the time being we have no first-hand information. For almost all of bosch’s works, no conclusive d.

programme.title: Masterpieces Unveiled
programme.desc: The image of the wealthy merchant from Lucca Giovanni Arnolfini shown together with his wife in the intimacy of their comfortable home in Bruges has always been considered the brilliant figurative proof of the commercial and artistic relations between Italy and Flanders in the 15th century. However, there has been a certain amount of doubtful attention devoted to the figures for some time; in fact, the hypothesis that one of the maximum masterpieces of portraiture of all times may not depict the Arnolfinis at all, but the van Eycks, is not entirely new. It had already been cautiously suggested by the Director of London’s National Gallery over a century and a half ago, when the painting was purchased by the great museum, but the idea was soon cast aside by the objections of specialists. Other doubts about the couple’s identity have cropped up a number of times, juggled back and forth amongst the abundant historic information on the painting, archival research, and allegorical theori.

programme.title: Masterpieces Unveiled
programme.sub-title: Piero Della Francesca, The Montefeltro Altarpiece
programme.desc: For us today the Montefeltro Altarpiece, preserved in the Brera Art Gallery in Milan, is the “Altarpiece by Piero” par excellence. It is surprising to learn however, that until the late 1800s no one would ever have dreamed of attributing this impressive masterpiece to the hand of Piero della Francesca. For long centuries it was a deeply-rooted belief that the painter of the work was a certain Bartolomeo Corradini, a friar-painter known by the funny nickname of Fra Carnevale. It is in this guise that the Montefeltro Altarpiece came to Brera in 1811 and all the catalogues of the Milan Art Gallery repeated Fra Carnevale’s name until the end of that century. Piero della Francesca was simply forgotten... His name and his works ended up literally in the dust of oblivion until they disappeared from the horizon of history... His critical resurrection happened however, in the early 1900s, the century in which the Master painter wielded a powerful influence on the art of the first decades….

programme.title: Masterpieces Unveiled
programme.desc: The Birth of Venus... a masterpiece; central to Botticelli's oeuvre and the culmination of Florentine Neoplatonism.

programme.title: Masterpieces Unveiled
programme.desc: During the 20th century, the fame of the ‘Mona Lisa’ spread, establishing itself as the most iconic and recognisable painting of all time. It has been exploited in every sphere of culture and advertising, to the extent that its status as a pop icon has almost overshadowed its artistic value and historical significance. But if we consider Leonardo’s achievements as a pioneering craftsman and the unprecedented qualities of this work, the ‘Mona Lisa’ truly marked a turning point in portraiture. A masterpiece that set new standards in its day and which, five hundred years later, has become the very symbol of art.

programme.title: Private Tour
programme.sub-title: Print in Bruegel's Time at BOZAR in Brussels
programme.desc: Private Tour takes you to the discovery of the exhibition "the print at the time of Bruegel" at BOZAR in Brussels. Here you can discover the rich collection of the Royal Library of Belgium. It is possible to observe prints of the artist Pietr Bruegel, but also of other artists of the 16th century.

programme.title: Within The Frame
programme.desc: Rembrandt est largement considéré comme le plus grand peintre Néerlandais du 17ème siècle. Il est maître dans l’usage des lumières, particulièrement dans la technique du clair-obscur, c’est un dessinateur exceptionnellement talentueux. Le travail de Rembrandt a été considérablement influencé par les événements dramatique de sa vie ( La mort de sa femme, sa faillite financière, etc..). Dans cette exposition vous allez découvrir ses peintures les plus célèbres exposés au Louvre, comme « Bethsabée au bain tenant la lettre de David » ,mais également exposé à Mauritshuis avec « La Leçon d'anatomie du docteur Tulp » ou encore ces fameux autoportraits.Bonne visite !

programme.title: Architectures
programme.desc: La Pyramide de Djoser, la plus ancienne pyramide égyptienne - 2 600 AJC révèle sans doute les tous premiers pas de ce qu'on appelle l'architecture, comme pratique savante, distincte de la simple construction. Le lieu où s'opère cette coupure est un monument funéraire, où la fonction symbolique prend le pas sur le simple usage. L'architecture à sa naissance s'affirme d'emblée non pas comme fonction mais comme signe. A trente kilomètres au sud du Caire, à l'est la vallée du Nil, Saqqarah fut la nécropole de Memphis, la première capitale de l'ancienne Égypte, dont il ne reste rien sauf cet immense cimetière dominé par les soixante mètres de la pyramide à degrés de Djoser.

programme.title: Artist's Workshop

Whether they are painters, visual artists, sculptors... These people all have the same passion for art and this show is an opportunity to enter their different universes, to discover what drives them, inspires them and maybe that will give rise to vocations.

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Les coachs vocaux et couple marié David et Carrie Grant échangent l'harmonie vocale contre une compétition acharnée d'antiquités. Avec l'aide des experts Will Axon et Mark Stacey, le couple découvre des objets inattendus à vendre lors d’une vente aux enchères dans la campagne du Norfolk.David fait une halte sur un terrain d'herbe en plein cœur de Cambridge, où aujourd'hui les enfants jouent et les chiens se promènent, mais qui était en réalité le berceau du football. Pendant ce temps, Carrie découvre comment Letchworth Garden City a déclenché une révolution dans la conception des villes.

programme.title: Photo Contest
programme.desc: In each episode of Photo Contest, two contestants compete on an imposed theme such as rock'n roll, Japan or architecture. They have one hour to take the best possible photographs before editing them for 30 minutes in a studio. The photographs they have selected are then presented to Agnès Grégoire, editor-in-chief of PHOTO magazine, who will have to choose the best photographer.

programme.title: Artist's Workshop
programme.desc: Joaquin Boz habite et travaille à Buenos Aires. C’est ici, dans la capitale de l’Argentine, qu’il pratique son art à mi-chemin entre abstraction et performance corporelle. Sa peinture est recouverte de couches toujours plus nombreuses. Ces tâches, ces mouvements, ces traits et ces raclures, sont le fruit de la transmission des formes et des couleurs depuis son corps vers la toile dans une performance physique de l’artiste qui puise son inspiration dans le courant expressionniste.

programme.title: An hour with
programme.desc: Take an hour break to discover the work of an Italian painter, Caravaggio. You will discover his labour with Bacchus, Mary Magdalene or Christ at the Column.

programme.title: An hour with
programme.desc: Take an hour break to discover the work of a Italien painter, Sandro Botticelli.You will discover his labour with Abundance or autumn, The story of virginia, Venus and Mars.

Their first show was scorned by the critics, but the group had acquired a new name: the Impressionists. For the next 40 years Pissarro was the driving force behind what has today become the world’s favourite artistic movement.The Ashmolean Museum has a long tradition of excellence. As the UK’s first ever public museum (it opened its doors in May 1683) it houses a wonderfully rich collection, including the remarkable Pissarro archive. With exclusive access to most extensive archive of.

programme.title: Within The Frame
programme.desc: La Dulwich Picture Gallery abrite une collection au destin incroyable ! En 1790, le roi de Pologne passa commande à deux marchands d’art installés à Londres. Ceux-ci achetèrent des peintures à travers l’Europe, qui restèrent en leur possession après l’effondrement de la Pologne. Ils léguèrent la collection au Dulwich College et, selon leur vœu, le premier musée d’art public anglais ouvrit ses portes en 1817. Découvrez ainsi des chefs d’œuvres de la main de Poussin, Rembrandt ou Murillo. Bonne visite !

programme.title: Within The Frame
programme.desc: Discover or re-discover the masterpieces of the greatest painters of history through our documentary series Within The Frame. From impressionists to surrealists, from Leonard Da Vinci to Paul Cézanne, every episode will immerge you into a virtual tour of a paintings collection. You will see the most impressive paintings ever made and won't miss a single detail.

programme.title: Sketchbook
programme.desc: Raphael Federici (street artist), Marine Goodmorning (illustrator), Luca Fiore (cartoonist) and Harry Boudchicha (drawing teacher) reveal their best drawing techniques. Each episode focuses on a specific subject:movement, oil painting, shadows, hair... For the first 10 minutes, each artist gives a theoretical lesson illustrated by sketches. Then they each start working on their creation. Finally, they end with a debrief, comparingand explaining their techniques.

programme.title: Little Sketches
programme.desc: In 64 fun episodes, Gia-Haï Phan teaches you all the sketching techniques you need.

programme.title: Architectures
programme.sub-title: Charlety, a stadium in the city
programme.desc: Découvrez un bâtiment de l’architecture classique, moderne ou contemporaine avec une « leçons d’architecture » conjuguant rigueur, plaisir et intelligence. Au stade Charlety, les architectes ont réussi à concilier les contraires : la grandeur monumentale du stade avec celle du quartier, la vie d’une cité sportive avec celle des bureaux. Situé à la porte de Gentilly à Paris, coincé entre le périphérique et le boulevard des Maréchaux, le stade Charléty est bordé des pavillons de la Cité universitaire, d’un cimetière et de HLM en briques rouges. Sur ce site difficile de huit hectares, marqué par les cinquante ans d’histoire de l’ancien stade Sébastien-Charléty, Henri Gaudin et son fils Bruno ont su implanter le volume massif d’un stade de 20 000 places couvertes, ainsi que les équipements sportifs et les bureaux commandés par la Ville de Paris. En concevant ce grand stade avec sa forme d’anneau gigantesque, ses gradins en ellipse et sa toiture aérienne, les architectes ont su traduire l’é.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: With loans from across the world, this major retrospective brings together Vermeer’s most famous masterpieces including Girl with a Pearl Earring, The Geographer, The Milkmaid, The Little Street, Lady Writing a Letter with her Maid, and Woman Holding a Balance. In all, 28 of his surviving 37 works. This film invites audiences to a privileged view of the exhibition, accompanied by the director of the Rijksmuseum and the curators of the show. A truly once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to discover the genius of Vermeer and his fascinating and mysterious life.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: Phil Grabsky, réalisateur récompensé à plusieurs reprises, pose un regard neuf sur celui qui est sans conteste l’artiste le plus aimé au monde en utilisant les mots du peintre lui-même. Moi, Claude Monet révèle de nouvelles facettes de l’homme qui a donné naissance au mouvement impressionniste grâce à un tableau et qui fut certainement l’un des peintres les plus influents et renommés du XIXe et du début du XXe siècle. Tourné à travers l’Europe, sur les lieux où il a peint, Moi, Claude Monet est une exploration filmique inédite et intime de certains des décors cultes les plus appréciés de l’art occidental.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: « Les Tournesols » sont parmi les tableaux de Van Gogh les plus célèbres. Le musée Van Gogh à Amsterdam a consacré une exposition à ces œuvres et « Exhibition on screen », qui a eu un accès exclusif à l’événement, nous guide à travers l’exposition pour enquêter sur les mystères qui entourent ces tableaux. Le film nous amènera également à Tokyo, Philadelphie, Londres et Munich pour suivre les 5 principales œuvres de l’exposition.

programme.title: Within The Frame
programme.desc: Léonard De Vinci est le peintre Italien de la renaissance le plus célèbre. Il possède un talent inégalable (peintre, sculpteur, architecte, ingénieur, urbaniste, mathématicien, botaniste, philosophe, inventeur,…) Il a considérablement influencé l’histoire de l’art. Son usage de la technique Sfumato et du clair-obscur son encore étudié aujourd’hui. La « Mona Lisa » et « La Cène » exposé au Louvre et dans l'église Santa Maria delle Grazie qui apparaissent dans cet épisode font partie de ses peintures les plus renommé, admiré et parodié à travers le monde.Bonne visite !

programme.title: Within The Frame
programme.desc: Discover or re-discover the masterpieces of the greatest painters of history through our documentary series Within The Frame. From impressionists to surrealists, from Leonard Da Vinci to Paul Cézanne, every episode will immerge you into a virtual tour of a paintings collection. You will see the most impressive paintings ever made and won't miss a single detail.

programme.title: My little Museum
programme.desc: My little Museum is Art History retold through funny anecdotes and backstage trivias by Alicia Flipo. With her wacky demeanor, her inventiveness and her quirky sense of humor, Alicia stages these small Art tales so that once and for all, you could remember the Big stories!

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Aujourd’hui, on relève le piquant avec les gastronomes gourmets Tony Singh et Cyrus Todiwala. Les chefs sont accompagnés de David Harper et Natasha Raskin.Partant de Dundee, ils descendent la côte est de l’Écosse jusqu’au village de Rosewell, dans le Midlothian, pour une vente aux enchères. Cyrus démontre un talent certain pour négocier, tandis que Tony n’hésite pas à afficher ses prix.Tony découvre pourquoi une ville écossaise a été le foyer de nombreux millionnaires, et Cyrus prend ses marques en mer en apprenant pourquoi Anstruther était un port de pêche clé au XIXe siècle.

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Deux stars des années 70, le crooner cool Tony Christie et la royauté pop Jimmy Osmond, sont accompagnés des experts Catherine Southon et Margie Cooper. Partant de la ville de Loughborough, dans le Leicestershire, ils se dirigent vers une vente aux enchères à Stoke-on-Trent, dans le Staffordshire.Tony profite d'une visite à Coalbrookdale, le lieu où des techniques innovantes ont été développées, marquant le début de la révolution industrielle. De son côté, le passionné de voitures Jimmy s'offre un tour sur le circuit historique de Donington.La grande finale aux enchères comprend un moment de chant en groupe unique en son genre. Mais quel maestro musical remportera la victoire ?

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Les coachs vocaux et couple marié David et Carrie Grant échangent l'harmonie vocale contre une compétition acharnée d'antiquités. Avec l'aide des experts Will Axon et Mark Stacey, le couple découvre des objets inattendus à vendre lors d’une vente aux enchères dans la campagne du Norfolk.David fait une halte sur un terrain d'herbe en plein cœur de Cambridge, où aujourd'hui les enfants jouent et les chiens se promènent, mais qui était en réalité le berceau du football. Pendant ce temps, Carrie découvre comment Letchworth Garden City a déclenché une révolution dans la conception des villes.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: Based on a major exhibition at the Ashmolean Museum in Oxford, Tokyo Stories spans 400 years of incredibly rich art, from Hokusai’s prints to Pop Art posters, via contemporary photography, manga, cinema and street art. The exhibition was a huge success and attracted a significantly younger and more diverse audience than usual. The film draws on the exhibition to take us to Tokyo and explore the city’s art and artistic figures in greater depth. A superbly illustrated and richly detailed documentary, which traces the journey of a metropolis marked by ceaseless cycles of destruction and rebirth throughout its 400-year history, to become one of the most dynamic and fascinating cities in the world today.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: Pablo Picasso est l’un des plus grands artistes au monde, et jusqu’à sa mort en 1973, il était le plus prolifique. Comment tout a commencé ? Comment s’est construit Picasso ? Après avoir été trop longtemps ignorées, il est temps de se concentrer sur les jeunes années de l’artiste et son éducation qui lui ont permis d’accomplir l’extraordinaire. Trois villes ont joué un rôle-clé : Malaga, Barcelone et Paris. "Le jeune Picasso" les traverse et explore leur influence sur l’artiste, en analysant des œuvres spécifiques de ses débuts.

programme.title: Graffiti World
programme.desc: Graffiti World is a short program dedicated to contemporary urban art around the world. Each episode explores a specific city, highlighting iconic works of street art. Local soundscape accompanies the images for an authentic, commentary-free immersion. The program showcases the creativity and diversity of artistic expression in public spaces. An invitation to discover the richness of graffiti as an art form in its own right.

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.sub-title: Lynne Faulds Wood and John Stapleton
programme.desc: Un Road Trip en couple de célébrités – les journalistes primés John Stapleton et Lynn Faulds Wood.Ils sont rejoints par Thomas Plant et Margie Cooper pour cette aventure. Avec 400 £ chacun, les équipes commencent à Wrightington, dans le Lancashire, et se dirigent vers Stockport pour une vente aux enchères.Lynn et Thomas se retrouvent littéralement jusqu'aux genoux dans des antiquités en cherchant de vieilles boîtes à biscuits, tandis que Margie tente de convaincre John que des lampes rares feront un joli profit.John apprend comment un Américain a révolutionné les transports publics britanniques, et Lynn découvre pourquoi on traite du lait de serpent à Liverpool.

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Actor and charmer Nigel Havers and his canny, deal-making chum (and ex-agent) Michael Whitehall explore the West Country. Travelling by Bentley and TVR, they’ll have £400 each and expert advice from Margie Cooper and James Braxton. But what will do best at the auction... Nigel’s old cockle bucket or Michael’s tambourine? Plus there’s a trip to see some Bristol Savages and bit of Georgian elegance with the story of ‘The King of Bath’.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: Cette exposition très attendue à la Royal Academy of Arts était la toute première rétrospective consacrée au portrait d'Édouard Manet. Couvrant l'ensemble de la carrière de cet artiste énigmatique et parfois controversé, l'exposition a rassemblé des œuvres provenant d'Europe, d'Asie et des États-Unis. Le portrait de Manet n'a jamais fait l'objet d'une exposition, bien qu'il représente environ la moitié de sa production artistique. Il a peint sa famille, ses amis et les personnalités littéraires, politiques et artistiques de l'époque, donnant vie non seulement à ses sujets mais aussi à la société parisienne.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: The Kiss by Gustav Klimt is one of the most recognised and reproduced paintings in the world. It is perhaps the most popular poster on student dorm walls from Beijing to Boston. Painted in Vienna around 1908, the evocative image of an unknown embracing couple has captivated viewers with its mystery, sensuality and dazzling materials ever since it was created. But just what lies behind the appeal of the painting – and just who was the artist that created it? Delving into the details of real gold, decorative designs, symbolism and simmering erotica, a close study of the painting takes us to the remarkable turn of the century Vienna when a new world was battling with the old.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: 200 years after it opened and a century after acquiring its first Van Gogh works, the National Gallery hosted the largest Van Gogh exhibition ever held in the UK (September 14, 2024 to January 19, 2025). The exhibition was a huge success, unanimously praised by the press, and tickets sold out quickly, making this film the only way to see what Forbes called a “once-in-a-lifetime exhibition.”Discover the passion that drove one of the world's most beloved artists to revolutionize art. Van Gogh: Poets & Lovers rewrites history and celebrates Van Gogh's genius without exploiting his suffering, allowing audiences to truly understand this iconic artist in a whole new way...

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: Hopper’s work is the most recognisable art in America – popular, praised, and mysterious. Countless painters, photographers, filmmakers and musicians have been influenced by his art – but who was he, and how did a struggling illustrator create such a bounty of notable work?This new film takes a deep look into Hopper’s art, his life, and his relationships. From his early career as an illustrator; his wife giving up her own promising art career to be his manager; his critical and commercial acclaim; and in his own words – this film explores the enigmatic personality behind the brush….

programme.title: Within The Frame
programme.desc: “Happiness is an angel with a serious face.” These words by the Italian painter Amadeo Modgliani define to perfection the portraits which made him famous… He reinvented the icon, with his oval faces, his elongated necks and lapis-lazuli eyes which are strangely expressive even when robbed of substance. You will be able to appreciate the simplicity of his figures, the restraint in his lines and colours, especially when you admire “The Woman with the Blue Eyes” or the “Portrait of Anna Zborowska”. Enjoy your visit!

programme.title: Within The Frame
programme.desc: L’art d’Edgar Degas est difficile à classer, cependant il est souvent associé au mouvement impressionniste, qui a émergé en France à la fin du 19ème siècle. Néanmoins, il a développé un style très personnel avec une préférence pour les sujets intérieurs plutôt que les scènes en plein air favorisées par les peintres impressionnistes. Les 10 oeuvres présentées dans cet épisode illustrent parfaitement les préférences thématiques d’Edgar Degas : Le spectacle, le bain, les portraits de famille et les classes de travail. Découvrez " La Classe de danse " exposé au Musée d'Orsay ou encore " Les Danseuses bleues " au Musée des Beaux-Arts Pouchkine.Bonne visite !

programme.title: Architectures
programme.desc: Architecte et urbaniste, Kenzo Tange est l'un des architectes les plus influents de sa génération; il a initié le Japon à l'architecture moderne, découverte dans le travail des maîtres. Il fut, en 1987, le premier Japonais à recevoir le prix Pritzker, la plus haute distinction mondiale en architecture. Il faut remonter à la défaite du Japon après la deuxième guerre mondiale et aux années qui ont suivi : l'occupation du Japon par les Américains, son absence de la scène internationale, sa lente reconstruction économique pour comprendre la vraie origine des 2 gymnases olympiques construits par Kenzo Tange pour les Jeux Olympiques de 1964. Il est rare qu'un bâtiment incarne autant d'ambitions : celles d'un architecte et d'une équipe de 25 jeunes architectes et urbanistes, celles d'une ville, celles d'un pays décidé à redevenir une puissance mondiale.

programme.title: Artist's Workshop
programme.desc: In the Artist's workshop series, we offer you a privileged meeting with an artist, or the discovery of an artist or an important place for the history of art. Whether they are painters, visual artists, sculptors... These people all have the same passion for art and this show is an opportunity to enter their different universes, to discover what drives them, inspires them and maybe that will give rise to vocations.

programme.title: Artist's Workshop
programme.desc: C’est dans le centre de Buenos Aires qu’Eduardo Stupia a décidé d’installer son atelier entièrement dédié à la création. Dans une maison du XXe siècle, coincé entre deux immeubles modernes, il occupe un large espace dans lequel il peut se livrer à son art de prédilection, le dessin. Ses œuvres, qu’il décrit lui-même comme des paysages abstraits, sont tracées au crayon, au fusain, ou à l’encre de Chine. Dans ses compositions hétéroclites, où le langage graphique et la précision du geste tiennent une place centrale, Eduardo Stupia explore la sémantique du dessin et ouvre le champ de l’imagination.

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Les actrices et amies de Casualty, Susan Cookson et Suzanne Packer, troquent leurs blouses de chirurgie contre une Sunbeam Tiger de 1965 pour se lancer dans une compétition à travers le Nord-Ouest de l’Angleterre, accompagnées des experts James Braxton et David Harper.Susan découvre son côté négociatrice, tandis que Suzanne garde un œil très vigilant sur le budget, cherchant à trouver un objet vraiment ancien.Au fil du voyage à travers le Yorkshire, elles ont l'opportunité de rencontrer une femme très spéciale de Sheffield et de visiter des jardins incroyables avec une histoire fascinante.

programme.title: Photo Contest
programme.desc: In this episode, the two candidates Stéphany Mora and Harleena will compete on an imposed theme. Today, the theme is vineyards. They will have one hour to take the best picture possible. Let’s see who will win.

programme.title: Artist's Workshop
programme.desc: In the Artist's workshop series, we offer you a privileged meeting with an artist, or the discovery of an artist or an important place for the history of art. Whether they are painters, visual artists, sculptors... These people all have the same passion for art and this show is an opportunity to enter their different universes, to discover what drives them, inspires them and maybe that will give rise to vocations.

programme.desc: Take an hour break to discover the work of a Italien painter, Leonardo da Vinci.You will discover his labour with the Joconde, Salvator Mundi, The Cène.

programme.desc: Take an hour break to discover the work of a Netherlands painter, Rembrandt.You will discover his labour with The night round, the return of the prodigal son, Danaé.

programme.title: Home training
programme.desc: This episode of "Home Training" presents an original and enjoyable lower-body workout with the use of a chair. Guillaume and Sabrina invite participants to make some space and grab a chair for a variety of fun and engaging exercises. The focus is on strengthening the legs and glutes while making the session accessible and entertaining. This program is ideal for effectively working the lower body muscles using simple and easy-to-use equipment.

programme.desc: In this sports show, our coaches invite you to do a fitness session on different themes and different parts of the body in each episode. To prepare for the session, our sportsmen and women show you how to do a gentle, gradual warm-up. This is followed by an intense workout, with explanations from our coaches on how to reproduce the movements correctly. Then comes the stretching session at the end of the session, and finally “The Nutrition Minute” concludes each episode with a practical tip.

programme.title: Health Investigation
programme.desc: In France, the menopause affects more than 11 million women, and every year a further 400,000 women experience it for the first time. Occurring at an average age of 51, the menopause marks the start of a new phase of life – a period that is becoming longer as life expectancy increases. Yet it remains a taboo subject about which very little is known. Hot flushes, sleep and mood disturbances, weight gain, reduced libido… The drop in hormone levels can trigger symptoms that vary greatly from one woman to another. Some women experience none at all, whilst others experience many. And whilst the menopause is not an illness, it can increase the risk of serious conditions such as osteoporosis or cardiovascular events. Screening for risk factors is therefore a public health priority. Yet France lags far behind in the management of the menopause.Once touted as a panacea, hormone replacement therapy (HRT) has been at the centre of a major controversy for the past twenty years or so, accused of.

programme.title: Big Little Footprints
programme.desc: We travel to an idyllic island in the South Pacific, known for its enviable coral reef and chance to swim with giant Manta Rays! We also visit the local village to learn about its important relationship with the resort and hear how tourism has helped.

programme.title: Health Investigation
programme.desc: With 8 million dogs and 14 million cats, the French hold the world record for pet ownership. Whilst these four-legged companions soothe and stimulate us, they actually do much more than that: they heal us! And this has been scientifically proven. Having a pet at home has numerous benefits for our physical and mental well-being.Better cardiovascular health, a stronger immune system and gut microbiota, and the release of oxytocin – the ‘happiness hormone’… There are countless studies demonstrating the physical, psychological and emotional benefits of this bond between humans and animals.For the past forty years or so, animal-assisted therapy has been growing in popularity in France. Dogs, cats, horses and certain farm animals now work alongside therapists to offer a new approach to care. In care homes, dogs help to rekindle the desire to communicate in elderly people suffering from Alzheimer’s disease. For children with psychomotor disabilities, horses facilitate functional rehabilitat.

programme.title: Big Little Footprints
programme.desc: From cute Koalas to the world heritage Great Barrier Reef, this family ticks off seeing two of Australia’s biggest icons and learning about their vulnerability and how as tourists we can help.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Summer is the season when vegetables abound in the garden, but it would be a shame not to savor those that the cooler seasons have to offer: soups, pies, stews or gratins highlight seasonal vegetables, perfect for a nice warm up. To begin this new journey, Julie will cook salsify. This little tour of France will also allow us to meet gardening goldsmiths who sculpt winter vegetables and fruits. Finally, we will conclude as usual with a recipe from a chef, who will go out of his way to create a seasonal recipe for us.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Today, Julie takes us down a different kind of yellow-brick road, one that tastes of childhood and gourmet delights: the road of sweets. France may be famous for its gastronomy, but it's not to be outdone when it comes to pastries and confectionery - quite the opposite. “Bêtises” from Cambrai, "Berlingots” from Carpentras, "Calissons” from Aix-en-provence, every region in France has its own sweet or confectionery.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Eating flowers might appear unconventional, but we often consume them without even realizing it. Consider artichokes, for instance : they are essentially large, unopened flowers. Capers are the preserved buds of flowers soaked in vinegar, and cloves are dried flower buds. We also find courgette flowers, saffron pistils, orange blossom water used to flavor pastries, and the violet sweets that evoke memories of our childhood. In addition to adding aesthetic appeal and providing a dose of vitamins to our plates, flowers elevate the flavors of a dish and can even serve as a vegetable substitute.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: This week, it is 80 kms from the capital, in Fontainebleau, that Julie is putting down her bags. Fontainebleau, a name famous throughout the world, a magical name which evokes for some a forest, for others a castle, a name which still shines with its royal history. The forest of Fontainebleau has inspired the art world since the beginning of the 19th century. Landscape painters such as Corot and Millet drew inspiration for their works there. But Fontainebleau has many other treasures in its bag, and gastronomy is part of its heritage. This is what Julie will discover through three recipes: Quail with grapes, raspberry and poppy pie and crayfish grave.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: It is in Giverny that Julie's journey begins, the place whose name resounds as the cradle of Impressionism has kept a moving authenticity. Its fame is strongly linked to the historical presence of Claude Monet and to all the fabulous witnesses left by him. Claude Monet also left his mark on the cooking in Giverny. His recipe books are there to testify to this. It’s with these notebooks that Julie will be inspired to fill hers, on the menu: Rabbit in compote, andouilles puff pastry with camembert, and apricot charlottes.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Julie heads for Burgundy to discover ancient breeds of poultry reintroduced to France thanks to the work of breeder Fred Ménager. We'll then move on to Auvergne to discover how the famous Label Rouge is awarded and the role of certifying bodies ... because it's important to know what ends up on our plates. Julie also travels to the Drôme to cook guinea fowl, before heading to the Périgord to prepare a turkey stew. Julie will then head back up towards the center to discover an amazing fly maker who uses rooster feathers!

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Today, Julie sets on the roads of France to talk about an essential product on French tables: cheese. More than a gourmet craze, more than an end-of-meal treat, cheese is associated with French gastronomy, and is also recognized as Intangible Cultural Heritage by UNESCO. With nearly 1,000 varieties (soft cheeses, cooked, blue-veined, pressed cheeses…), the French are the biggest consumers of cheese in the world!

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Julie takes you through the Pyrénées Orientales, then Corsica, before making a stop on the Côte d'Azur, and concludes her journey between Rungis and Paris... all to explore the world of citrus fruits! These fruits add flavor, zest, and seasoning to any recipe, making them indispensable in the kitchen. They bring the warmth and sunshine of the South of France and the exoticism of distant lands. While we're all familiar with lemons, clementines, and grapefruits, Julie introduces us to a thousand other varieties.

programme.title: Luana's Kitchen
programme.desc: What a delight to find this springtime fruit! Strawberries bring color back to our plates and provide us with a healthy dose of vitamins and antioxidants. In this episode, Luana Belmondo reveals two sweet strawberry recipes.

programme.title: Luana's Kitchen
programme.desc: For the lazy and those who don't have the time, Luana Belmondo offers two simple and effective recipes. Discover her garlic and cheese bread, and her garlic spaghetti.

programme.title: 100 Places to See
programme.desc: The Quercy region reveals architectural gems and enchanting landscapes. Rocamadour, a town clinging to its cliffs, Saint-Cirq-Lapopie, a picture-postcard village, and Castelnau-Bretenoux, a fairy-tale fortress, illustrate the richness of a land where tradition and history come together in perfect harmony.

La concurrence arrive avec Aurélie, 31 ans, professeur d'arts plastiques.

programme.desc: In this sports show, our coaches invite you to do a fitness session on different themes and different parts of the body in each episode. This is followed by an intense workout, with explanations from our coaches on how to reproduce the movements correctly. Then comes the stretching session at the end of the session, and finally “The Nutrition Minute” concludes each episode with a practical tip.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Head north to discover a French city that cannot be ignored: Lille. The city has an exceptional architectural heritage, a merchant town since the Middle Ages, a citadel under Louis XIV, an industrial town in the 19th century... it expanded over the centuries. Julie will meet those who contribute to the fame of the city and its region, through its culinary heritage with the menu of this journey: the recipe of the coq à la bière, that of the hochepot and for a sweet note, a crème brûlée with chicory. .

programme.title: Yoga
